about_the_game:
Build beautiful 3D dioramas that come to life! No quests, no timers and no leveling – just a relaxed experience to tackle at your own pace. This is the PC adaptation of the indie VR hit with over 3.000 reviews. 

This demo includes the tutorial and a curated selection of puzzles from the main game, playable in Arcade and Tabletop modes in both VR and flatscreen, to give you a quick hands-on introduction to Puzzling Places' core features and gameplay!

Discover Unique Places

Pick your puzzle: In this demo, you can explore a small selection of intricate puzzles made from 3D scans of real world locations!

Pick Your Challenge

Looking for a quick, 5min puzzle in between tasks? Or an epic, multi hour challenge? 
Try out our two game modes:

  • Tabletop Mode: start with all the pieces, sort arrange and build the fractured diorama piece by piece like a real world jigsaw.

  • Arcade Mode: Short on time? Build your puzzle a handful of curated pieces at a time! Ideal for flow and building puzzles over multiple quick sessions!

Each puzzle in this demo is available in 25, 50, 100, 200, 400 pieces - and some even 800 pieces! Whatever you’re in the mood for, Puzzling Places can offer a satisfying escape from everyday life.

About the developers

Founded in 2016, Realities.io is a pioneer of 3D photography. Realities.io’s technology has powered the early Steam VR app Realities, a number of award winning VR films and experiences, including Home After War, which was awarded “Best Use of Immersive Arts” at SXSW 2019, and the megahit VR puzzle game Puzzling Places.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Processor: Intel i5 7th gen or better
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 970 or similar
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: optional: SteamVR compatible or Meta Quest headset
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Processor: Intel i7 7th gen or better
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Geforce GTX 1070 similar
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • VR Support: optional: SteamVR compatible or Meta Quest headset

short_description: Arrange, connect and relax as you puzzle satisfying 3D dioramas of beautiful locations from around the world! No quests, no timers, no pressure - just puzzle at your pace, in short dips or epic puzzle sessions!
supported_languages: English, French, German, Japanese, Korean, Spanish - Latin America
